decision.reason: W1-10 and W2-00 are not GREEN; the current Workshop API exposes only module catalog and readiness and has no unified operations view envelope

sourceReadiness.rule: historical obj_instance or ecom_object rows cannot be promoted to current operational facts while the latest source runs are failed

perSliceRequirements: latest run ref status and error code
row and active counts with declared denominator
scoped subject Evidence Task Action and Case refs

authorityBoundaries: the view is a rebuildable L1 projection and never becomes Order Inventory Shipment Payment or event authority
OperationCase and AggregationPolicyRevision require canonical L0 authority before the corresponding slices can be READY
aftersale data must map to an approved canonical object or event contract; it cannot be inferred from refund-like fields or UI labels
client supplied org project cutoff readiness permission or aggregate totals are rejected
missing source cutoff quality or query capability produces blocked or unknown rather than zero
raw provider primary keys and address payment customer or secret payloads never enter subject refs logs or receipts
stateAndCountInvariants: module readiness and every source slice readiness remain separately visible
order header line payment shipment and case counts have explicit denominators and are not added together
late duplicate deleted partial and unknown records remain in reconciliation accounting
empty means an eligible current query returned zero; failed stale forbidden unknown and blocked are distinct
cross-object joins retain originals lineage and expose unmatched counts instead of silently dropping rows
requiredTestsWhenUnblocked: strict DTO and SDK parser including extra enum time hash cursor and count failures
store query tenant scope no-scope wrong-scope cross-tenant and field redaction
source freshness quality cutoff and latest-run precedence
Order OrderLine ProductSku Shipment Payment join and unmatched-count conservation

org-org positive and dev-org negative browser states without fixture fallback
